system.description:
The best defence is often to disarm the attacker: any weapon raised against you shatters against your skin from the sheer force of its own blow.

Activate for one Blood Trait, lasting the scene. Whenever you are attacked, win a Simple Test to shatter the offending weapon — a melee weapon is destroyed, an unarmed striker's hand or foot is broken and disabled, and a headbutter takes double damage and is stunned for a round; a stake used against you likewise shatters harmlessly. Bullets still deal their damage even as they shatter, and non-physical attacks (such as a Fire Bolt) are unaffected.
